messages:
Ana (Design): Quick review thread 1: new compact 'compare p95' concept in Figma: https://figma.com/file/efgh5678 Ana (Design): One-line: inline 'Compare' switch in p95 header, hover scrubber with delta overlay, and a collapsed compact mode for long model lists. Jonah (Eng): Nice. How does the scrubber play with sampling? fetching full traces per hover will kill perf. Ana (Design): Plan: client-side delta using cached bucketed p95s. Only request backend for full absolute numbers or deep trace when user clicks 'inspect'. Matt (PM): Product preference: default to relative (%) comparison so regressions jump out. Add 'show absolute' toggle in tooltip for ops folks. Sarah (SRE): Agree on relative default. Also we need explicit sampling presets so compact mode doesn't mask regressions. Proposal: Live (1%), Stable (10%), Full (100%). Queenie (A11y): Accessibility checklist: keyboard operable toggle, clear focus order, screen-reader label for scrubber, and fix contrast on delta text (currently around 2.8:1). Need >= 4.5:1. Ana (Design): Updated microcopy suggestions: - Switch label: "Compare to baseline" (help: "Compare current p95 to the selected baseline window") - Scrubber tooltip header: "Delta: +12% (p95) 120ms 135ms" - Sampling presets: radio group with short descriptions Jonah (Eng): Rough estimate: ~2 dev days to wire the toggle + tooltip + tests, +1 day for presets. Extra if backend endpoints required for absolute fetch. Ana (Design): ARIA prototype: ```
Scrubber delta: +12%
``` Queenie (A11y): Recommend aria-roledescription="scrubber" on the scrubber container, explicit focusable handles, and ensure tooltip content is discoverable via keyboard and SR. Matt (PM): Filed a ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INF-4923 1 Acceptance: default relative, sampling presets, A11y notes, perf budget. design-bot: Uploaded image: compact-compare-v2.png :frame_with_picture: Ana (Design): I'll iterate in Figma, add the accessibility checklist to the ticket, and update the mock. Thanks everyone :heart: Matt (PM): SGTM :thumbsup: Jonah (Eng): I'll slot this for next sprint. Sarah (SRE): Can we add a small smoke verification job post-rollout to catch sampling regressions? Ana (Design): Added to the ticket as follow-up. Done.
